name: Obfuscate (Dark Ages) — Advanced — Cloak the Gathering

system.description:
You can extend your concealing powers to others, hiding them from observation or granting them disguises. Expend one Mental Trait for each person (other than yourself) you wish to affect, then manifest any single Obfuscate power upon them, granting each a different disguise, making them all vanish, or conveying them unseen. Perform any challenges once as if affecting only yourself, but apply the results to the whole group.

If one of the people you are shielding breaks concealment or is detected by Auspex, only she becomes visible; if you break concealment or are detected, the entire group becomes visible. The concealment does not affect visibility among group members themselves.
